summary: PicPay (NASDAQ: PICS) filed a Form 6-K announcing receipt of final regulatory approval from the Central Bank of Brazil for its acquisition of Kovr Participações S.A., a digital insurance technology company. The transaction had previously cleared Brazil's antitrust regulator (CADE) and insurance regulator (SUSEP). No price, premium, or stake size were disclosed. The deal will allow PicPay to integrate vertically into insurance, combining its distribution platform with Kovr's product capabilities. Closing remains subject to customary conditions; consolidation will follow. Watch for the closing announcement and integration milestones.
